text:
jessica: quick handoff — heading out in ~30m. watchlist for tonight: prefetched-kv latency spikes in eu-2, encoder-pool cycling in rtx-pool-3, and noisy TTL-expiry alerts on cache-writer. running notes below.

marta: ack. any expected deploys or config changes?

jessica: no planned deploys. we rolled a small autoscaler tweak ~2h ago and rolled back; spikes line up with a canary synthetic surge around 02:15 UTC.

alex: saw the same in logs, digging now. quick grep I ran:
```
grep -c "prefetch.*latency" /var/log/prefetch/2026-03-18.log | tail -n 20
```

sam: pinging infra to check if a node drain/maintenance caused the rtx-pool-3 thrash.

oncall-bot: alert: prefetch_latency_p95 > 250ms (eu-2) — currently auto-suppressed by heuristic for 2m

marta: suggestion — temp suppression rule for noisy bursts in eu-2, apply 15m TTL: 
```
WHERE cluster = 'eu-2' AND metric = 'prefetch_latency' AND window = '5m' AND p95 > 300
```
will annotate with sticky note and escalation path.

devex-bot: added dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/test/prefetch-eu-2 (panels: p95, p99, synthetic-traffic)

jessica: note on KV-ttl alerts: these are expected to spike when the eviction sweeper runs. treat TTL spikes as informational unless accompanied by write-errors or cache-miss storms. escalate only if write_errors > 0 or miss-rate > 10%.

alex: copying a quick encoder restart check I ran:
```
journalctl -u encoder.service --since "2 hours ago" | grep restart | tail -n 10
```

sam: infra update — one host in rtx-pool-3 had oom-score adjust triggered and showed repeated dapic restarts, they rebooted it and bumped oom_kill config. lasting impact should be low.

marta: thanks. I'll own watch until 04:00 UTC. if anything spikes further @alex will take over.

jessica: checklist before I go:
- temporarily suppress eu-2 p95 alert (15m) and annotate why
- watch kv write-error rate and miss-rate; escalate if write_errors > 0
- confirm encoder restarts stop and that rtx-pool nodes stabilize
- post any sustained spikes to #eng-paging

marta: ack :thumbsup:

alex: ack. I'll set a short-forward to #eng-paging for write_errors > 0 and leave a pager rule note.

jessica: final — no user-facing degradation expected at this time. logging: annotate handoff in the runbook at /handovers/2026-03-18/prefetch-oddities with these links and grep snippets.

oncall-bot: handoff recorded by jessica at 2498761234
